findings.quote: Cozy 2-bedroom, 1-bath bungalow on a quiet cul-de-sac, freshly painted, move-in ready.
Master bedroom features a walk-in closet and large east-facing window.
Updated kitchen with granite counters, walk to schools and the neighbourhood park in under 10 minutes.
Non-smoking unit. Small pets considered with landlord approval.
No children please — this home is best suited for a quiet, mature couple.
